input.command:
cd /tmp/obench-cell-rdv_4ot8/bench_opencode_model-extraction-relu-logits_rfp7s_lo && rm -f stolen_A1.npy && s=$(date +%s); python steal.py | head -1; echo "took $(( $(date +%s)-s ))s"; python -c "
import numpy as np, forward
A=forward.A1; S=np.load('stolen_A1.npy')
An=A/np.linalg.norm(A,axis=1,keepdims=True)
C=S@An.T; j=np.abs(C).argmax(1)
print('rows',len(S),'matched distinct',len(set(j)))
print('min signed cos',C[np.arange(len(S)),j].min())
print('max abs err after rescale',np.abs(S*np.linalg.norm(A[j],axis=1,keepdims=True)-A[j]).max())
"
